rule: A 2004 pick belongs to the club that held it on the symmetric league's activation date (2003-12-03): every real trade link dated before that day and not involving real Miami applies; links on or after it are real moves the simulated clubs did not make (docs/symmetric_league_design.md), and the June 2004 Charlotte-Clippers swap of No. 2 for Nos. 4 and 33 is one of them. Ownership is by the original club's pick, whatever slot the simulated lottery and records give it.

forfeited.note: Minnesota's 2004 first-round pick was forfeited by league sanction (2000), before the career; it applies.

expansion.note: Charlotte holds No. 4 in each round by expansion terms (sourced in the draft class file) and does not enter the lottery.

notes.16: NYK keeps its 1st: NYK->PHO (Jan 5, 2004) and PHO->UTA (Feb 19, 2004) are after activation.
notes.17: MIL's 1st is Detroit's (MIL->DEN 2001, DEN->DET 2002); DET->ATL (Feb 2004) is after activation.
notes.23: MEM keeps its 1st: the Wesley Person/Bonzi Wells trade is dated on the activation day itself.
notes.25: DET keeps its own 1st: the Feb 2004 Rasheed Wallace trade is after activation.

notes.42: GSW's 2nd is Philadelphia's (June 26, 2002); PHI->ORL (Dec 23, 2003) is after activation.
